canonical_comment: Legacy calls and expectations are preserved. A canonical step supplies explicit fixed input/expectation differences with a contract reason; no runtime accept-actual or version replacement is allowed. Missing expected fields may be asserted as null under the subset rule; default false/empty fields are omitted by canonical serde.
